generation.scope: All ordered traceless triples with smooth commutator determinant are recovered through a six-dimensional linear space over auxiliary determinantal representations of the same cubic. The nonsingular symmetrizer locus is nonempty exactly away from two-torsion, and the class of the actual commutator representation is minus twice the auxiliary class in Pic^0. Thus every smooth target up to independent left and right bases has exactly four auxiliary classes, including the fixed-metric exceptional cubics. Actual bases follow by linear comparisons; special-fiber AS is a separate condition.

open_mathematics: Use the fourfold elliptic inverse and six linear lift coordinates to determine irreducibility, generic regularity, and periods over fixed smooth discriminants including fixed-metric exceptions. For targets with already fixed bases, determine the remaining simultaneous-conjugacy fibers. Extend the symmetrizer method to nodal and cuspidal cubics.
